claims.exact_statement: For a unital CPTP Hilbert-Schmidt-self-adjoint Phi with a supplied two-output CPTP broadcaster B whose two marginals are Phi, let Gamma=B^*. In a Stinespring dilation of Gamma, the normalized trace of the Schwarz defect for either copy of a Hermitian A is delta(A)=<A,(I-Phi^2)A>_tau, and 0<=delta(A)<=2<A,(I-Phi)A>_tau. The inequality includes negative Hilbert-Schmidt eigenvalues of Phi.
assumptions: Phi is CPTP, unital, and Hilbert-Schmidt self-adjoint
B is CPTP and both partial-trace marginals equal Phi
No Hilbert-Schmidt positivity assumption on Phi
claims.novelty_boundary: Direct Stinespring derivation recorded in this branch; no external novelty or priority claim. It does not prove an EB comparator.
claims.costs: Dimension-free exact inequality; finite matrix operations only. No algorithmic rounding is included.
claims.falsifier: An exact admissible example violating the Stinespring compression identity or scalar bound would refute the claim; no such example is known, and the identity follows algebraically.
claims.next_gate: Use the compression certificate only as an input to a proved common-POVM rounding, retaining operator-norm and frame-size costs.

claims.exact_statement: For all Hermitian A,B, ||[A,B]||_{2,tau} <= 3 sqrt(2) (||B||_infty sqrt(e(A)) + ||A||_infty sqrt(e(B))), where e(A)=<A,(I-Phi)A>_tau. Also ||[Phi(A),Phi(B)]||_{2,tau} <= sqrt(2)(||A||_infty sqrt(e(B))+||B||_infty sqrt(e(A))).
assumptions: Phi is unital CPTP and Hilbert-Schmidt self-adjoint
A supplied CPTP two-output broadcaster has both marginals Phi
claims.novelty_boundary: Independent compression representation for the commutator estimate; not claimed externally novel. Fixed-tuple almost-commuting prior is not a growing-frame result.
claims.costs: Constants are dimension-free, but input operator norms are explicit. For HS-unit directions those norms can be sqrt(d-1), so there is no dimension-free normalized-HS frame bound here.
claims.falsifier: A legal finite-dimensional channel/broadcaster and Hermitian A,B violating (6). Numerical replay covers only three qubit fixtures and does not certify all cases.
claims.next_gate: Prove one canonical POVM controls every positive weighted frame using this estimate with explicit frame-rank, operator-norm, margin, and rounding losses.

claims.exact_statement: For arbitrary A,B in M_d, the marginal satisfies ||Phi(AB)-Phi(A)Phi(B)||_{2,tau} <= min{||A||_infty sqrt(2 e(B)), ||B||_infty sqrt(2 e(A))}, where e(X)=tau(X^*(I-Phi)X).
assumptions: Phi is unital CPTP and Hilbert-Schmidt self-adjoint
A supplied CPTP two-output broadcaster has both marginals Phi
claims.novelty_boundary: The direct broadcaster Stinespring proof is the contribution recorded here; Schwarz-defect and approximate-multiplicativity themes are standard, so no novelty claim is made.
claims.costs: Dimension-free normalized-L2 bound, with explicit operator-norm factors. It gives no operator-norm multiplicativity or finite-dimensional rounding modulus.
claims.falsifier: An exact admissible example violating the compression formula or bound; none known.
claims.next_gate: A theorem must convert this L2 defect to a single measurement/EB Loewner comparison without an uncharged dimension or frame factor.

claims.exact_statement: For the symmetric universal qubit cloner, the canonical EB map induced by independent Haar rank-one measurements on both outputs has Z-score 4(2-2 ln 2)/9 < 1/3, while the target 2 Phi-I has Z-eigenvalue 1/3. For the copying Z-dephasing broadcaster, the canonical map induced by the symmetric-subspace coherent POVM has Z-score 3-3 pi/4 < 1, while the target eigenvalue is 1.
assumptions: The named standard symmetric qubit-cloner and copying-dephasing broadcasters
The exact named fixed POVMs, with canonical maps induced through B^*
claims.proof_path: PROOF_AND_GATE.md, equation (9) and following paragraph; checks/check_product_haar_failure.py
claims.novelty_boundary: These refute only two channel-independent fixed-POVM shortcuts. They are neither legal counterexamples to the channel-adaptive all-Q theorem nor priority claims.
claims.costs: Closed-form one-dimensional integrals; script uses 256-point Gauss-Legendre quadrature as a replay.
claims.falsifier: A correction to either broadcaster's output-state formulas, induced POVM normalization, or integral evaluation.
claims.next_gate: Any universal proof must choose an adaptive POVM or an operator-algebraic measurement construction; neither fixed covariant POVM works across these two extremes.

Equivalently, no proof or legal broadcaster/positive-dual global moment-envelope counterexample to the all-Q support gate was obtained.
assumptions: Full-domain operator order on the Hermitian Hilbert-Schmidt space
One finite canonical POVM/map must work simultaneously for all observables
The POVM may depend on Phi, its supplied broadcaster, and the dual Q used in the support criterion
